features.title: Link and watch GitHub pull requests from DSH threads
features.summary: Durably links GitHub.com pull requests to threads, polls each watched repository and number every two minutes through gh, queues concise state transitions, and asks thread-sidebar to settle merged or closed threads.
features.currentSurface: agent tools and Host watcher; no UI
failureModes: If gh is missing, unauthenticated, or returns an invalid response, the watcher keeps its last known state and records a bounded error code; a later poll retries.
GitHub rate limits increase a persisted per-PR delay exponentially from two minutes up to one hour.
If thread-sidebar is not loaded, the state still updates and the Host logs that notification or settlement was skipped.

externalDependencies.boundary: Runs gh repo view for number-plus-cwd links and gh pr view with state, mergeable, mergeStateStatus, reviewDecision, statusCheckRollup, comments and reviews; uses the CLI's configured login without reading or storing credentials. GitHub.com only.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: tests/pull-request-model.spec.ts supplies fixed CLI-shaped JSON to the production Effect Schema decoder; tests/host.spec.ts uses a real test Host without invoking GitHub.
